Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from this match. The series is already done and dusted in favour of Pakistan but there is still one game to go. On Monday, 22nd November 2021, the third T20I will be played at the same venue. The action will begin at 2 pm local (8 am GMT) but as usual, you can join us in advance for the build-up. Cheers!

Babar Azam, the winning captain of Pakistan, says that it was a team effort and they carried on with their winning momentum. Tells that the bowlers did a great job, in all the phases, and pressurized the Bangla batters. Mentions that they prepare themselves for all kinds of totals and it's important not to relax seeing a small total. He appreciates the knocks of Mohammad Rizwan and Fakhar Zaman. Admits that he is a little disappointed with his own batting but it's a part and parcel of the game and he will try to better it in the next match.

FAKHAR ZAMAN GRABS THE PLAYER OF THE MATCH AWARD! Says that the way pitch was playing, it was not easy to play shots but they had time to build a partnership. Shares that the pitch was better than the first T20I, not an ideal one but it was a better strip. Tells that whenever you play outside your country, it's important to win games and they will try to win the last match as well.

Mahmudullah, the captain of Bangladesh, says that they started well with the bat, praises Afif Hossain and Najmul Hossain Shanto for their stand but feels that they didn't capitalize in the last few overs. Tells that the boys are putting a lot of effort into the practice sessions but they are unfortunately missing out on the catches. Adds that the bowling unit has been outstanding and reiterates that the batting unit has to come up with the good things.
Presentation coming up shortly...

Bangladesh were outplayed once again. Their issue with the bat remained the same and once again that department was the sole reason for this defeat. Having said that, after losing their openers cheaply, Najmul Hossain Shanto and Afif Hossain put up a responsible stand and it appeared that the hosts will get a score close to 140-150. But one bad shot selection from Afif resulted in his departure and from there, Bangladesh's batting innings slipped. Their bowling once again was impressive, every bowler tried but they didn't have enough runs on the board. The Tigers were also sloppy in the field, putting down a couple of catches, and need to pull up their socks. Another concern for them will be the fitness of Mustafizur Rahman who walked off the field and we still are not sure about the kind of injury he has suffered.

Pakistan's bowlers once again did the bulk of the job. They were accurate and effective in executing their plans and corrected the mistakes that they committed in the first T20I. The bowling at the death was fabulous as they choked Bangladesh and restricted them to a paltry total. In pursuit, Pakistan sized up the conditions quite well, knew that it's not going to be easy to play shots and decided to carefully shape the chase. The required rate was never demanding, so Fakhar Zaman and Mohammad Rizwan had time to plan their innings and the duo smartly stitched a match-winning alliance of 85 runs. Babar Azam with the bat was the only disappointment for them in this game but given the class of Babar, it should not be an issue for Pakistan.

Easy win for Pakistan and they have taken an unsurpassable lead in the 3-match T20I series. It was yet another commanding show from them and they have handed Bangladesh only their second series loss in T20Is at home since 2018.

There it is! Fakhar Zaman hits the winning run and Pakistan seal the T20I series! Loopy ball, outside off. Zaman reaches out and drives it hard towards sweeper cover. The batters cross for a run and PAKISTAN WIN THE MATCH BY 8 WICKETS!
Saif Hassan to have a bowl now.
Flatter ball, around off. Fakhar Zaman taps it to covers and takes a run. Pakistan are just 1 run away from sealing the series.
BEATEN! Nicely tossed up, outside off, turning away sharply. Fakhar Zaman prods to block it but the ball spins past the outside edge.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Haider Ali cuts it to sweeper cover and collects a single.
Flatter ball, on middle, turning in late. Haider Ali tucks it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Cut away! Short and wide outside off, Haider Ali rocks back and cuts it past the point fielder to collect a boundary.
Tossed up, on middle. Haider Ali turns it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up and outside off, this time Zaman attempts to sweep it from far out there but fails to collect. A decent over by Shanto. 7 needed more.
Play and a miss! Shanto bowls it slower through the air and gets a full ball to turn away from the left-hander. Fakhar tries to go inside-out over covers but misses.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Fakhar chops it down towards short third man.
TWO WIDES! Sharp spin there. Turning down the leg side, Ali swings his bat at it but misses. Nurul also fumbles and they cross.
A touch short and around middle, Haider works it off his pads but finds the fielder at square leg.
Loopy and around leg, Haider goes down to sweep but fails to connect. It goes off his pads to backward square leg.
Fuller and outside off, it's driven through covers for a single.
Bowling change. Najmul Hossain Shanto to roll his arm now.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Haider Ali looks to cut but he misses. 10 runs needed off 24 balls.
A very full ball, around leg. Fakhar Zaman looks for the slog-sweep but gets an under-edge and the ball goes towards deep square leg. A single taken.

Shorter in length, around off. Haider Ali hits it back to the bowler who dives but does not stop the ball. The ball hits the stumps at the non-striker's end and ricochets towards mid off. The batters take a single.
Haider Ali is the new batsman.

OUT! TAKEN! Finally, finally, Islam has something to celebrate as the fielder takes it this time! Tossed up, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan skips down and looks to go downtown but he gets a thick outside edge and the ball goes in the air towards Saif Hassan at short third man who does not make any mistake this time around.
Commentary.Howout: c Saif Hassan b Aminul Islam

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, around middle and leg. Fakhar Zaman turns it to the leg side for a run.

DROPPED! It is definitely not Aminul Islam's day today, that's the second catch put down off his bowling! Tossed up, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan looks to sweep but he only manages a top edge and the ball goes in the air towards Taskin Ahmed at short fine leg. He runs behind but drops an easy catch. The batters cross for a single.
Aminul Islam to bowl his last over.
Shouts of catch it, but the ball falls short of the deep mid-wicket fielder. Short ball, outside off. Rizwan pulls it towards deep mid-wicket and takes a run. 14 runs needed off 30 balls now!
A slower ball, into the pitch, outside off. Fakhar Zaman stays back and steers it uppishly towards third man for a run.
Full ball, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan drives hard and aerially but straight towards mid off. The fielder there does not stop the ball cleanly as it drops in front of him. They cross for a single.
A low full toss, on leg. Fakhar Zaman whips it to deep mid-wicket for a run.

FIFTY! Short ball, around leg. Fakhar Zaman pulls it towards deep square leg for a single. The fielder in the deep scores a direct hit at the striker's end and the ball ricochets off the stumps. The batters take one more. A fine knock from Zaman, he struggled a bit initially but has now played a brilliant knock.

SIX! BANG! Fakhar Zaman looks in a hurry to finish the game now! Fractionally short and around off. Zaman sits back in his crease and smokes it way, way over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. The crowd now is not bothered about the result and is just enjoying some good cricket.
Back of a length again, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan looks to play at it with an angled bat but he misses.

Another overthrow and the batters take a single! Back of a length, on middle and leg. Fakhar Zaman advances down the track for a big heave-ho but only manages to drag it to mid-wicket. He looks for a run but is sent back. The fielder at mid-wicket has a shy at the striker's end but misses. The ball goes to third man and now the batsmen cross.
SIX! Nicely done by Fakhar Zaman! Islam bangs it into the deck, outside off. Zaman stays back and plays the ramp shot over third man for a biggie.
Short of a length, on middle, Fakhar Zaman looks to heave it away but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
Good-length delivery, around off. Fakhar Zaman taps it towards backward point. Zaman wants a single but is sent back by Rizwan.
What happened there? Mustafizur Rahman is seen walking off the field. He is limping a bit. Doesn't look good. Shoriful Islam to complete the over.

Back of a length, darted on the pads. Mohammad Rizwan looks to whip it behind square on the leg side but he gets an inside edge onto his pad. The ball rolls away to the leg side and the batters sneak in a leg bye.
Mahmudullah is ringing in the bowling changes. He has brought Mustafizur Rahman back into the attack. 1/11 in his 2 overs so far.
Back of a length, around off. Mohammad Rizwan hangs back and runs it down to third man to keep the strike for the next over. 34 runs needed off 42 balls.
Short of a length, outside off. Fakhar Zaman stays back and cuts it towards sweeper cover for a run.
Play and a miss! A slower ball, into the pitch, outside off and staying a bit low, Fakhar Zaman looks to cut it but the ball sneaks under his bat.
Taskin bends his back and hurls a bumper, outside off. Fakhar Zaman lets it through to the keeper.
Back of a length, outside off. Fakhar Zaman cuts it past the point fielder and takes a couple of runs. The fielder in the deep does well to save two runs for his side.

Shout for a caught behind! It's not given and Bangladesh opt for a review, more in hope. Nothing on the UltraEdge, review lost. Back of a length and outside off, angling away, Fakhar Zaman flashes his bat at it but fails to middle his shot. There wasn't much noise, maybe some deflection and that prompted the bowler to appeal. Mahmudullah takes the DRS but it's of no use.
Taskin Ahmed is back into the attack.

Overthrow and the batters take a run! Flatter ball, around off. Fakhar Zaman taps it to backward point. The fielder there collects the ball and throws it towards the keeper. The throw is a bit wayward and the batters steal a single. 38 runs needed from 48 balls.
Short ball, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan rocks back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. A single taken.
FOUR! Easy pickings! A full toss, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan runs down the track and smacks it over the extra cover fielder for a boundary.
Floated, around leg. Fakhar Zaman plays the reverse sweep towards deep point for a run.

FOUR! DROPPED! Oh, dear! Nothing going Bangladesh's way and Saif Hassan has dropped a sitter at deep mid-wicket! Loopy ball, just outside off. Fakhar Zaman gets low and slog-sweeps it. He does not middle it and gets a top edge. The ball loops up in the air and goes straight to Saif Hassan at deep mid-wicket. He makes a mess of it and the ball pops out of his hands. Saif tries to slide and stop it from reaching the fence but in the process, made contact with the ball and the fence at the same time. Poor, very poor from the young man. Bangladesh dropped as many as 12 catches during their T20 World Cup campaign and it appears that they have not learnt anything.
Flatter ball, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan hangs back and guides it to short third man for a run.
Wide! Islam errs in line and spills it way outside off. Mohammad Rizwan lets it be. Wided!
FOUR! SMASHED! Tossed up, around off. Fakhar Zaman gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a boundary. 51 runs needed off 54 balls.
A bit short, outside off. Fakhar Zaman cuts hard but fails to find the gap and hits it to backward point.
Flatter and quicker, around middle, Mohammad Rizwan tucks it to the leg side and rotates the strike.
Loopy ball, outside off. Fakhar Zaman drills it to long off for a single now.
Flatter ball, around middle. Mohammad Rizwan backs away and strokes it to deep cover for a single.
Tossed up, on middle, Fakhar Zaman advances down the track and looks to go downtown but he only manages a thick inside edge. The ball goes behind square on the leg side and the batters take one.
A dot to end the over! Loopy ball, way outside off. Mohammad Rizwan drives hard but straight to the extra cover fielder. 50 up! 59 more to get at the halfway mark.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Fakhar Zaman punches it towards sweeper cover for one.
Tossed up, way outside off. Mohammad Rizwan reaches out and carves it towards deep cover. A single taken!
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Rizwan tucks it wide of long on and collects a couple of runs.
FOUR! Punished by Rizwan! A juicy full toss, quite high. Rizwan whacks it to the vacant deep square leg region for a boundary.
Loopy ball, outside off. Fakhar Zaman drills it towards long off and takes one.
Flatter ball, around off. Fakhar Zaman nudges it to covers and takes off for a single.
Nicely tossed up, around middle and leg. Mohammad Rizwan prods and works it behind square on the leg side to rotate the strike.
Short ball, outside off. Fakhar Zaman stays back and strokes it to deep cover. The batters cross for a run.
Just a tad short, outside off. Fakhar Zaman cuts it wide of deep cover and takes a couple of runs.
On a length, around off. Fakhar Zaman blocks it off the front foot.
Flatter ball, outside off. Fakhar Zaman looks to punch it off the back foot but it goes off the outer half towards backward point.
Shorter in length, around off. Fakhar Zaman rocks back and works it to long off for a single. Just 4 runs off the over!
A bit flatter and quicker, around middle. Mohammad Rizwan eases it to long on for a run.
Quicker and shorter in length, outside off. Fakhar Zaman hangs back and strokes it to deep cover for a single.
Flatter ball, on middle and leg. Fakhar Zaman turns it to mid-wicket.
Another short ball, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan stays back, swivels and pulls it along the ground towards deep square leg for a run.
Almost, chopped on! A half-tracker, outside off. Mohammad Rizwan looks to pull but he gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Aminul Islam to bowl his leggies now.
Flatter ball, around middle. Fakhar Zaman pushes it off the back foot back to the bowler. A tidy over from Mahedi Hasan as just 5 runs came off it!
Mohammad Rizwan backs away so Mahedi Hasan follows him and hurls a length ball. Rizwan cuts it towards cover-point for a single.
Flatter and quicker, darted on the pads. Fakhar Zaman turns it on the leg side off the inside edge. The ball rolls to mid-wicket and he collects a run.
Just a tad short and wide. Fakhar Zaman cuts it past the point fielder for a couple of runs.
Tossed up, around off. Fakhar Zaman prods and blocks it towards covers.
Flatter ball, darted on the pads. Mohammad Rizwan stays back and tucks it to the leg side for a single.
Mahedi Hasan comes back to bowl.
Another delivery around leg, Rizwan tucks it to deep square leg and keeps strike. At the end of the Powerplay, Pakistan are 27/1, needing 82 more for a win.
A slight halt in play as the groundsman puts some sawdust near the bowler's landing area.

Shout for an lbw! Not given and the keeper gestures that it's high. Fractionally short and around leg, angling away, Rizwan is on his toes as he tries to work it away. He misses and is pinged on the back thigh pad.
Width outside off, Fakhar runs it down to third man from the bottom end of his bat and picks up a single.
Around off on a good length, Rizwan stays back and plays it down with soft hands. The ball rolls in front of the point fielder and they pinch a single.
This one is bowled closer to off, on a length again, Rizwan tries to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Angling away from the batsman, on a good length, Rizwan shoulders arms.
Shoriful Islam comes to bowl now.
SIX! Boom! Don't feed him room. It's in the zone around off, Fakhar Zaman shimmies down the track, makes more room for himself and whacks it over extra cover for a thumping biggie. 9 from the over.

NOT OUT! Pitching outside leg. Rahman serves it on a length around leg, Rizwan tries to flick but misses and it goes off his pads to backward square leg. The batsmen cross as the bowler puts in an appeal. The umpire turns it down and Mahmudullah takes the referral. The replays confirm that pitching is an issue.

A review for LBW taken by Mahmudullah after Mohammad Rizwan has been struck high on his pad! The Ball Tracker suggests that the ball had pitched outside the leg stump so the on-field decision stays and Bangladesh lose a review!
Slashes and misses! Mustafizur Rahman tempts the batsman with a short delivery wide outside off, Rizwan goes chasing after it but fails to connect.
This one is angled in around off, on a length and it straightens a touch after landing, Fakhar stays back and taps it down to point for a quick run.
A bit too straight in line, it's worked through square leg for a single.
Full and around middle, nipping back in, Rizwan covers the movement and pushes it defensively to mid on.
Fullish and on off at 89 mph, Rizwan falls across a bit in his stance as he eases it towards mid on. Collects a quick run to end the over.
Pitches it up and around off, Zaman pushes it to extra cover where the fielder dives to make a partial stop. He parries it towards mid off and they collect a single.
Swing and a miss! Fractionally short and outside off, the angle of the bowler takes it away from the southpaw, Fakhar tries to heave over the leg side but misses.
Sharp delivery, a touch short and around off, Rizwan shuffles across to play on the leg side but misses. It deflects off his pads to square leg and they cross.
Angling in from a length around off, Rizwan walks forward and across before defending it late with an angled bat to point.
That's a peach from Taskin. He hurls it across on a length outside off, Rizwan gets forward to play at it but the ball nips back in to beat the inside edge.
Width on offer outside off, Fakhar makes the connection with his square cut but finds the point fielder. A top over by Mustafizur Rahman.
Extra pace and lift from the surface, outside off and shooting up, Fakhar throws his bat at it but gets beaten again. Nurul jumps to catch the ball over his head.
Beaten! On a length and outside off, Fakhar flashes his bat at it but misses.
Fakhar Zaman comes out to bat now.

OUT! Chops it on! Mustafizur Rahman strikes to remove Babar Azam early. The Fizz purposefully serves it wide outside off, on a good length at 80.2 mph, Babar goes chasing for it but only manages a big inside edge. The ball deflects onto the stumps and the crowd gets a reason to cheer. Once again Babar departs for a low score, something we are not used to seeing from him.
Strays on the pads of the batsman, Rizwan tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
Quick run. Fuller and straighter on middle, Babar bunts it down to mid on and scampers across to the opposite end. The Pakistan skipper is off the mark.
Wide! Wrong start from The Fizz. Serves it on a length but down the leg side at 81 mph, Babar tries his best to flick but misses.
Mustafizur Rahman comes into the attack.
Some exaggerated movement on this occasion. The ball lands on a good length outside off, at 87.8 mph, curling away, Rizwan keeps his bat close to his body and lets it be.
Back of a length around off, at 87.9 mph, Rizwan gets closer to the delivery and taps it down to point.
Taskin lets out a big grunt as he hurls across a shortish delivery outside off at 86.5 mph, Rizwan shoulders arms.
FOUR! Nicely done by the batsman. Taskin serves a pacy delivery, on a length around off at 89 mph, Rizwan uses the pace and runs it past the diving short third man fielder for a boundary.
Taskin gets closer to the off stump, it's on a length at 88 mph, Rizwan covers the line and then makes a leave.
Taskin begins with a delivery on the shorter side outside off, Rizwan allows it through to the keeper.
Who will bowl from the other end? Taskin Ahmed it is.
Mahedi pulls his length back slightly and dishes it out around off, Babar goes on the back foot in defense. Apart from the first ball, it was a good over by Mahedi.
Fuller and around middle, Babar flicks it on the leg side but finds mid-wicket.
Fuller and around middle, Babar looks to flick but gets a soft leading edge to covers.
Another flighted delivery, landing full and on middle, Rizwan works it in the gap at mid-wicket and takes a single.
Floated and full, around off, Rizwan presses forward and defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! A freebie from Mahedi. He serves a friendly full toss on middle, Rizwan goes down on one knee and smashes it in front of square leg for a boundary.
